figures.caption: Figure 1: Ethylene: (a) Pump-probe setup; (b) ground-state absorption (blue) and transient absorption (orange) spectra at time-delay 0.0 fs; (c) TAS spectra varying with time-delay (τ). (d) density weighted transition analysis for peak A at ω′ = 0.25 au; (e) imaginary part of electric dipole-electric dipole response function obtained from simplified non-equilibrium response function expression. Adapted from Reference 46. Copyright 2023 American Chemical Society.

Figure 2: Thiophene: (a) Sulphur L2,3-edge x-ray TAS at time-delay τ = 0.0 fs computed using 1c non-relativistic (orange), 2c amfX2c (blue) and 4c Dirac–Coulomb (cyan) Hamiltonians. Variation of TAS spectra with pump-probe time-delay computed at (b) 1c nonrelativistic and (c) 2c amfX2C Hamiltonian levels. Reproduced from Reference 46. Copyright 2023 American Chemical Society.

Figure 3: Furan: (a) Pump-probe setup; time-delay dependent transient electronic circular dichroism spectra of aligned furan pumped with (b) left and (c) right circularly polarized light; chiral induced (d) electron charge density ρind(r, t) and (e) current density j ind(r , t) generated by the circularly polarized light at the end of the pump pulse (t = T); (f) The time-dependent induced magnetic dipole moment and it´s Fourier transform. Adapted from Reference 75. Copyright 2025 American Chemical Society.

Figure 4: Tellurophene: Transient electronic circular dichroism spectra of alligned molecule at time-delay τ = 0.0 fs with circularly polarized left and right pump pulses obtained with (a) 1c non-relativistic and (b) relativistic Hamiltonians, namely 2c amfX2C and 4c Dirac– Coulomb.
